answer: Each epoch sells 100 entry slots by admission auction. Agents bid POA as a bond locked 20 epochs; the top 100 win, losers refunded. A raven pays one bid for one nest; a sparrow wanting a hundred nests must win a hundred. At a 40 POA clearing bid, 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA for 20 epochs, earning nothing; one honest agent pays 40 POA once and works every epoch. Each winning bid bears a jade seal, forfeited on cheating; honesty stays cheapest.
